extension.description: Explore local Kodi storage by category, add-on and folder. Compare code and saved data, inspect required/optional dependencies and active-skin references, then use Kodi add-on manager for removal. Read-only, cancellable scans; no cleanup or background service.
extension.news: Windows Python 3.8 compatibility verified; folder browsing refreshes stale Windows directory metadata. Independent of custom builds and TMDb Helper.
